title.en: Substation Equipment
2.1 Power and interconnecting transformers: scope first
title.gu: 2.1 Power તથા Interconnecting Transformers: પહેલાં વ્યાપ

h.en: Power and interconnecting transformers: scope first
h.gu: Power તથા Interconnecting Transformers: પહેલાં વ્યાપ

body.en:
Definition

A power transformer transfers ACpower between windings by electromagnetic induction at the same frequency; an interconnecting transformer links system voltage levels and may be an autotransformer where its insulation/earthing design permits.

Classification / scope

  • By duty: power/interconnecting/distribution; by winding: separate-winding/autotransformer; by cooling: oil/air arrangements according to actual rated design.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Power, interconnecting and distribution describe service context, not three unrelated physical laws. Stepping voltage up or down changes current inversely for approximately the same transferred apparent power.
  • An autotransformer has a common winding portion and does not provide full galvanic isolation between its connected systems. Neutral/zero-sequence behaviour and fault transfer need coordinated studies.
  • The source associates IS 1180with interconnecting transformers; correct scope: IS 1180concerns specified distribution transformers. Power/interconnecting specifications use the applicable power-transformer family and actual contract requirements. Unit 2standards remain reference-only, not exam-number questions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Power transformer સમાન frequency પર electromagnetic inductionથી AC power windings વચ્ચે transfer કરે; interconnecting transformer voltage levels જોડે અને insulation/earthing design યોગ્ય હોય તો autotransformer હોઈ શકે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Duty: power/interconnecting/distribution; winding: separate/autotransformer; cooling: actual rated oil/air arrangements.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Power, interconnecting/distribution service context બતાવે, જુદા physical laws નહીં.Same apparent powerમાં voltage/current આશરે inverse બદલાય.
  • Autotransformerમાં common winding હોવાથી systems વચ્ચે full galvanic isolation નથી.Neutral/zero-sequence/fault transfer coordination જરૂરી.
  • Sourceમાં IS 1180ને interconnecting સાથે જોડ્યું છે; IS 1180ની સાચી scope distribution transformers છે.Power/interconnectingમાં applicable power-transformer family/contract લો.Unit 2 standards reference-only છે, exam-number questions નહીં.

h.en: Transformer construction and how each accessory helps

body.en:
Definition

Transformer accessories support insulation, cooling, tap regulation, protection and safe condition assessment; an accessory must be interpreted within the actual transformer construction.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Laminated magnetic core and insulated windings establish flux and electrical transfer paths; insulation design handles operating and impulse stress.
  2. Tank and insulating liquid provide dielectric separation and heat transport; some designs use dry insulation instead of oil.
  3. Radiators, fans and pumps if fitted reject heat; cooling-stage availability limits permissible loading.
  4. Bushings carry insulated conductors through an earthed tank; test taps, grading and terminals require model-specific handling.
  5. Conservator, breather and Buchholz relay apply only where that oil system is fitted; sealed units have different arrangements.
  6. OLTC, temperature indication, pressure relief, oil level and protective relays provide regulation/monitoring/protection with independent functions.

Working / functional sequence

  1. ACflux induces winding EMF; load current transfers power while copper/core losses create heat.
  2. Insulation and cooling retain permissible temperature/stress; tap/protection systems act only within their specific ratings and logic.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Turns ratio governs induced voltage approximately; leakage impedance, load PF, losses and tap position affect terminal regulation. Do not infer current rating from voltage ratio alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Transformer accessories insulation, cooling, tap regulation, protection/condition assessmentને મદદ કરે; actual construction પ્રમાણે અર્થઘટન કરવું.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Laminated core/insulated windings flux/transfer paths આપે; insulation operating/impulse stress સહે.
  2. Tank/liquid dielectric separation/heat transport આપે; કેટલાકમાં oilને બદલે dry insulation છે.
  3. Radiators/fans/pumps હોય તો heat દૂર કરે; cooling availabilityથી permissible load નક્કી થાય.
  4. Bushings conductorsને earthed tankમાંથી insulated પસાર કરે; test taps/grading/terminals model-specific છે.
  5. Conservator, breather/Buchholz માત્ર fitted oil-systemમાં; sealed unitsમાં જુદી arrangement.
  6. OLTC, temperature, pressure relief, oil level/relaysનાં regulation/monitoring/protection functions જુદાં છે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. AC fluxથી EMF/load power transfer થાય; losses heat આપે.
  2. Insulation/cooling temperature/stress limits જાળવે; tap/protection specified ratings/logicમાં કાર્ય કરે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Turns ratio induced voltage નક્કી કરે; leakage impedance, PF, losses/taps terminal regulationને અસર કરે.માત્ર voltage ratioથી current rating નમેળવો.

body.en:
Definition

A transformer operational check confirms the required service state and available protection/cooling; maintenance assesses and corrects condition under an approved safe work plan.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Observe load, top-oil/winding indication, oil level, leaks, cooling state, breather, abnormal sound, alarm history and tap position against the unit’s approved loading guide.
  • Investigate a genuine protective trip before restoration; do not repeatedly re-energise a transformer after differential/Buchholz/pressure operation without authorised assessment.
  • Isolated maintenance may include bushing cleaning/inspection, joint torque checks, oil sampling, cooling checks, OLTC servicing and permitted electrical tests; test voltages and disconnected electronics follow the manufacturer.
  • Sampling preserves cleanliness, correct valve/sample identity, temperature and timing. BDValone does not assess every oil/solid-insulation problem.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Operational check required service state/protection-cooling availability verify કરે; maintenance approved safe planમાં condition assess/correct કરે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Load, oil/winding indications, level, leaks, cooling, breather, sound, alarms/tap position approved guide સાથે compare કરો.
  • Genuine protective trip પછી authorised assessment કરો; differential/Buchholz/pressure trip બાદ repeated energisation નહીં.
  • Isolated maintenanceમાં bushings, joints, oil sampling, cooling, OLTC/permitted tests હોય; test voltage/electronics isolation manufacturer મુજબ.
  • Samplingમાં cleanliness, valve/sample ID, temperature/time રાખો.BDVથી બધા oil/solid-insulation problems જાણી શકાતા નથી.

h.en: Condition monitoring: parameter, sensor, threshold, action
h.gu: Condition Monitoring: Parameter, Sensor, Threshold તથા Action

body.en:
Definition

Condition monitoring is repeated or continuous measurement interpreted against baseline, operating context and validated alarm/action limits to detect deterioration before functional failure.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Top oil/winding hot-spot estimate: temperature sensor/thermal model; interpret load, ambient and cooling state before comparing approved alarm/trip settings.
  • Oil gases: DGA oil sample or online gas analyser; gas pattern/rate/history can indicate thermal/electrical distress but one gas number is not a complete diagnosis.
  • Moisture: relative saturation/ppmwith temperature context; oil level: level sensor plus temperature; cooling: fan/pump feedback, current and flow if instrumented.
  • Bushing health: capacitance/tanδtrend, leakage/partial-discharge evidence under approved tests; connection health: thermal comparison under comparable load/emissivity conditions.
  • Threshold table must record parameter, sensor, normal baseline, manufacturer alarm/trip values, delay, data quality and responsible action. No universal temperature, DGAor insulation-resistance threshold fits every unit.
  • An IoTdashboard supports trending; it does not replace independent protection or authorise remote switching. Cybersecurity, time stamps and sensor-failure alarms are part of reliability.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Condition monitoring repeated/continuous measurementsને baseline, operating context/validated alarm-action limits સામે જોઈ deterioration વહેલી શોધવાની પ્રક્રિયા છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Top oil/hot-spot estimate માટે temperature sensor/thermal model; load, ambient/cooling સાથે approved settings compare કરો.
  • DGA sample/online analyserથી gases; pattern/rate/history distress સૂચવે, એક number complete diagnosis નહીં.
  • Moistureમાં saturation/ppm/temperature; oil levelમાં sensor/temperature; coolingમાં feedback, current/flow જુઓ.
  • Bushingમાં capacitance/tanδ, leakage/PD evidence; connectionsમાં comparable load/emissivity હેઠળ thermal comparison.
  • Threshold tableમાં parameter, sensor, baseline, OEM alarm/trip, delay, quality/responsible action લખો.Universal temperature, DGA/IR limit બધાને લાગુ નથી.
  • IoT dashboard trends માટે છે, independent protection/remote authorityનો વિકલ્પ નહીં.Cybersecurity, time stamps/sensor-failure alarms જરૂરી.

h.en: Transformer EMF: why frequency and flux matter
h.gu: Transformer EMF: Frequency તથા Fluxનું મહત્વ

body.en:
Definition

Induced winding EMFis the voltage produced by time-varying linked magnetic flux; its ideal sinusoidal RMSvalue depends on turns, frequency and peak core flux.

Detailed explanation and application

  • The derivation assumes sinusoidal common core flux and neglects leakage/resistive voltage drops; terminal voltage differs under load.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Let Φ(t)=Φm sinωt. By Faraday, e=N dΦ/dt=NωΦm cosωt(magnitude convention).
  2. Peak EMF=2πfNΦm; RMS=peak/√2, so E≈4.44fNΦm.
  3. For common flux/frequency, E 1/E 2=N 1/N 2; under the ideal approximation, V 1/V 2≈N 1/N 2 and I 1/I 2≈N 2/N 1.
  4. At fixed Vand N, reducing frequency increases required flux and can cause saturation. Ordinary steady DCdoes not provide repeated transformer EMF.

Worked example / interpretation

  1. For 50 Hz, 1000turns and 0.02 Wb, E≈4440 V. This is a sinusoidal illustrative calculation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Induced EMF time-varying linked fluxથી બનેલું winding voltage છે; ideal sinusoidal RMS value turns, frequency/peak flux પર આધારિત છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Sinusoidal common flux/leakage-resistive drops neglected; loadમાં terminal voltage જુદું હોય.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Φ(t)=Φm sinωt; Faradayથી magnitude e=NωΦm cosωt.
  2. Peak 2πfNΦm/RMS peak/√2થી E≈4.44fNΦm.
  3. Common flux/frequencyમાં E 1/E 2=N 1/N 2; ideal V 1/V 2≈N 1/N 2 તથા I 1/I 2≈N 2/N 1.
  4. Fixed V/Nમાં f ઘટાડવાથી flux વધે/saturation થઈ શકે; steady DC repeated EMF આપતું નથી.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / અર્થઘટન

  1. 50 Hz/1000turns/0.02Wbમાં E≈4440 V—sinusoidal illustrative ગણતરી.

title.en: 2.2 Isolator/disconnector: types and real switching duty

h.en: Isolator/disconnector: types and real switching duty

body.en:
Definition

A disconnector provides a rated isolating distance in its open position and carries its specified normal/short-time current when closed; it is not a general-purpose device for interrupting load or fault current.

Classification / scope

  • Break geometry, voltage/rated duty, manual/motor drive, and earthing-switch provision are separate selection axes.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Fixed/moving contacts and blades maintain contact pressure and isolating gap; insulators support live parts.
  2. Drive shaft, linkages, position indications, limit switches and padlocking points must agree with actual blade position.

Working / functional sequence

  1. In an approved switching plan, an appropriately rated breaker/load device removes the current before a non-load-break disconnector is moved.
  2. Open position permits the designed isolation function; work safety additionally needs authority, proof of dead and required earthing/permit measures.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Horizontal/vertical break, centre/double break, manual/motorised drive and with/without earthing switch classify geometry, actuation and auxiliary function—not automatic fault-clearing ability.
  • Some disconnectors have specific rated small-current or bus-transfer duties; only an approved design/order may use them. Ageneric training rule must not be stretched to those special duties.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Disconnector openમાં rated isolating distance આપે અને closedમાં specified normal/short-time current વહન કરે; તે generic load/fault interruption માટે નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Break geometry, voltage/duty, drive/earth-switch provision અલગ selection axes છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Fixed/moving contacts/blades pressure/gap જાળવે; insulators live parts support કરે.
  2. Drive/linkages, indicators, limit switches/padlocks actual blade position સાથે match હોવાં જોઈએ.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Approved planમાં યોગ્ય breaker/load device current દૂર કરે પછી non-load-break disconnector move થાય.
  2. Open position isolation આપે; work માટે authority, prove-dead/required earthing-permit પણ જોઈએ.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Horizontal/vertical, centre/double break, manual/motorised/earth switch classification geometry, drive/function બતાવે, automatic fault interruption નહીં.
  • કેટલાક disconnectorsને specific small-current/bus-transfer duty હોય; approved design/orderમાં જ વાપરો.Generic ruleથી special duty assume નકરો.

body.en:
Definition

A safety interlock prevents an incompatible equipment state or operating sequence; padlocking secures an identified mechanism but does not itself prove absence of voltage.

Detailed explanation and application

  • The usual design blocks closing the earth switch onto a connected live path and blocks reconnecting through an applied earth; mechanical and electrical interlocks provide complementary checks.
  • Correct device ID, local/remote selection, auxiliary contacts, independent blade/earth confirmation and permit conditions must be checked. Astale workstation indication is not physical isolation evidence.
  • Never defeat an interlock to complete a classroom exercise. Earthing-switch making/induced-current duty is rating-specific and is not a circuit-breaker interrupting duty.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Safety interlock incompatible state/sequence અટકાવે; padlock identified mechanism secure કરે પણ voltage absence સાબિત નથી કરતો.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • સામાન્ય designમાં connected live path પર earth-close/reconnection-on-earth block થાય; mechanical/electrical interlocks complementary છે.
  • Device ID, local/remote, contacts, blade/earth confirmation/permit તપાસો.Stale workstation status physical isolation evidence નથી.
  • Classroom માટે interlock defeat નહીં.Earth-switch making/induced-current duty rating-specific છે, CB interrupting duty નહીં.

title.en: 2.3 Busbars: classification, materials and functions

body.en:
Definition

A busbar is a common conducting node or assembly that collects and distributes power among substation circuits while carrying the specified continuous and short-circuit stresses.

Classification / scope

  • Mechanical form: flexible/strain or rigid; material: aluminium/copper/composite conductor; topology: single, sectioned, double and other bus schemes.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Flexible stranded conductors may be supported under tension(strain bus); rigid tubular/section bus uses support insulators and expansion allowances. These descriptions can overlap rather than being mutually exclusive species.
  • Aluminium tube, AAC, ACSRand copper are chosen for conductivity, weight, strength, corrosion and duty. ACSRcombines aluminium conduction with steel mechanical reinforcement.
  • Bus scheme determines switching flexibility; busbar material alone does not create a double-bus or sectionalised arrangement.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Busbar common conducting node/assembly છે જે circuitsમાં power collect/distribute કરે અને specified continuous/short-circuit stresses વહન કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Form: flexible/strain/rigid; material: aluminium/copper/composite; topology: single, sectioned, double/બીજી schemes.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Flexible stranded conductor tensionમાં strain bus બની શકે; rigid tube/section support insulators/expansion રાખે.Descriptions overlap થઈ શકે.
  • Aluminium tube, AAC, ACSR/copperમાં conductivity, weight, strength, corrosion/duty જોવાય.ACSRમાં aluminium conduction/steel reinforcement હોય.
  • Switching flexibility bus schemeથી છે; materialથી double-bus/sectionalised arrangement નથી બનતું.

body.en:
Definition

Busbar rating is the coordinated set of insulation, current-temperature and short-circuit withstand capabilities for the installed conductor, support and connection system.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Rated voltage/insulation level, rated continuous current, ambient/temperature rise, short-time RMSwith duration and peak withstand must all be specified. Ampacity is installation-dependent.
  • Fault electrodynamic forces relate strongly to peak current and conductor spacing/support geometry; thermal fault duty relates to I²t. Anormal-current check does not establish fault suitability.
  • Inspect isolated joints for torque/pressure, oxide/corrosion, cracked hardware, clearance and expansion freedom; use approved surface preparation and manufacturer torque values.
  • Thermography is a qualified non-contact inspection at safe distance; compare similar phases/loads and emissivity, not bare shiny-metal readings without context.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Local resistive heating P=I²Rjoint. At a fixed measured current, a resistance increase produces proportional extra heating.
  2. For 100Aand 100µΩ, P=1W; if resistance becomes 300µΩ, P=3W. This is an illustrative joint-loss calculation, not an alarm temperature.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Busbar rating installed conductor, support/connection માટે insulation, current-temperature/short-circuit withstandની coordinated capability છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Voltage/insulation, continuous current, ambient/temperature rise, short-time RMS/duration/peak withstand બધું specify કરો.Ampacity installation-dependent છે.
  • Fault force peak current/spacing/support પર અને thermal duty I²t પર આધારિત.Normal-current checkથી fault suitability નથી મળતી.
  • Isolated jointsમાં torque/pressure, oxide/corrosion, cracks, clearance/expansion જુઓ; approved preparation/OEM torque જ.
  • Thermography qualified safe-distance inspection છે; similar phases/load/emissivity compare કરો, context વિના shiny-metal reading નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Local heating P=I²Rjoint. Fixed currentમાં resistance પ્રમાણે heat વધે.
  2. 100 A/100µΩમાં P=1W; 300µΩમાં3W.આ joint-loss example છે, alarm temperature નહીં.

title.en: 2.4 Auto-recloser: clearing temporary versus permanent faults

h.en: Auto-recloser: clearing temporary versus permanent faults

body.en:
Definition

An automatic circuit recloser is a rated interrupting device with control logic that trips on defined faults and attempts a configured restoration sequence before either remaining closed or locking out.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Sense the defined fault and interrupt within the device/protection duty; start the configured dead time.
  2. Reclose only when permissives and the configured policy allow; retrip if the fault persists.
  3. Reset/reclaim only under the configured healthy interval or lock out after the permitted attempts; log each event with quality/time.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Single-phase and three-phase versions serve suitable feeder applications; shot sequence, dead time, reclaim/reset rules and protection coordination are engineered settings, not universal constants.
  • Temporary faults may clear during an open interval; permanent faults must not be repeatedly energised indefinitely. Lockout and authorised investigation limit damage/risk.
  • Contact wear, mechanism/counter records, control/DChealth, insulation, trip timing and event-clock accuracy inform maintenance; remote setting changes need approved authentication/change control.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Automatic recloser rated interrupting device/control છે જે defined faultમાં trip થઈ configured restoration attempts કરે અને પછી closed રહે અથવા lockout થાય.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Defined fault sense કરી rated dutyમાં interrupt/dead time શરૂ કરો.
  2. Permissives/policy મળે ત્યારે reclose; fault રહે તો retrip.
  3. Configured healthy interval પછી reset/reclaim અથવા attempts પછી lockout; દરેક event quality/time સાથે log કરો.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Single/three-phase versions feeder પ્રમાણે; shots, dead time, reclaim/reset/protection settings engineered છે, universal નહીં.
  • Temporary fault open intervalમાં clear થઈ શકે; permanent faultને અનંત energise નકરવો.Lockout/investigation જોખમ મર્યાદિત કરે.
  • Contact wear, mechanism/counters, control/DC, insulation, timing/clock maintenance માટે; remote settings authenticated approved changeથી જ.

h.en: Sectionaliser coordination: open in dead time

body.en:
Definition

A conventional counting sectionaliser isolates a downstream faulted section by counting upstream interrupting operations and opening during the de-energised interval; it does not itself interrupt fault current.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Ensure the sectionaliser can finish opening during recloser dead time and that a suitable restoration attempt remains. Load-break capabilities vary by design but do not imply fault interruption.
  • For an illustrative 3-trip lockout limit and 2-count sectionaliser, the second dead interval can isolate a permanent downstream fault before the next healthy restoration. This is a classroom sequence, not a field setting recommendation.
  • Status quality, distributed generation backfeed, fault-passage direction and communications failures must be addressed before remote restoration; “upstream breaker open” alone does not prove every conductor dead.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Conventional counting sectionaliser upstream trips ગણી de-energised intervalમાં downstream faulty section isolate કરે છે; તે પોતે fault current interrupt કરતો નથી.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Dead timeમાં opening પૂર્ણ થાય/પછી restoration attempt બાકી રહે તે coordinate કરો.Load-break capability હોવા છતાં fault interruption assume નહીં.
  • Illustrative 3-trip lockout/2-count sectionaliserમાં second dead interval પછી faulty part isolate/પછી healthy restore થાય.આ classroom example છે, field-setting advice નહીં.
  • Status quality, DG backfeed, direction/communication failures address કર્યા વિના remote restoration નહીં.Upstream CB openથી દરેક conductor dead સાબિત નથી.

title.en: 2.5 Surge arresters: classification and protective action
title.gu: 2.5 Surge Arresters: વર્ગીકરણ તથા Protective Action

h.en: Surge arresters: classification and protective action
h.gu: Surge Arresters: વર્ગીકરણ તથા Protective Action

body.en:
Definition

A surge arrester limits transient overvoltage by conducting surge current and then returning to a high-impedance state under normal system voltage; it is not a device for clearing sustained system faults.

Classification / scope

  • Expulsion; gapped silicon-carbide(Thyrite-type); metal-oxide(ZnO), with housing/duty according to equipment class.

Working / functional sequence

  1. During a surge, the nonlinear element or designed gap path conducts and diverts energy within its rating.
  2. After the surge, the design suppresses follow current/returns to high resistance; over-duty may cause failure and must be investigated.

Detailed explanation and application

body.en:
Definition

A substation insulator mechanically supports or separates conductors while maintaining the required electrical insulation and surface leakage path under specified environmental and voltage stresses.

Classification / scope

  • Material: porcelain/composite silicone-rubber; form/function: disc, long rod, hollow bushing, bus post.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Porcelain disc strings/long-rod insulators, composite long rods with silicone-rubber sheds, hollow bushings and bus-post insulators differ in mechanical duty and electric-field design.
  • Bushing is an insulated passage through an earthed enclosure; bus-post supports a live bus. Conductor clamps and spacers are associated hardware, not insulating material classes.
  • Wet pollution can create surface leakage, dry bands and flashover. Creepage distance, shed profile, material hydrophobicity and cleaning strategy require environmental design.
  • Silicone rubber is the polymer; silicon is an element. Inspect cracking, tracking, erosion, damaged sheds and hardware rather than assuming a polymer cannot degrade.

body.en:
Definition

A connector or clamp maintains mechanical restraint and/or an electrical joint without unacceptable heating, corrosion or conductor damage; spacers maintain the designed conductor geometry.

title.en: 2.7 PLCC: components, classification and signal path

h.en: PLCC: components, classification and signal path
h.gu: PLCC: Components, વર્ગીકરણ તથા Signal Path

body.en:
Definition

Power-line carrier communication sends a high-frequency communication signal over a power-line conductor using frequency-selective coupling and isolation while the line continues carrying power-frequency energy.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Carrier transmitter/receiver and modem process speech/data or protection commands.
  2. Coupling capacitor or suitable CVTcoupling, drain/protection devices, LMUand coaxial lead form the rated interface.
  3. Line-trap main coil, tuning network and protective elements define the carrier blocking band and current withstand.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Terminal modulates the message; LMU/coupling injects the carrier on the designated conductor.
  2. Trap restricts unwanted carrier escape into the bus; the remote coupling/terminal recovers the message.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Applications include voice, telemetry and appropriately engineered protection signalling; bandwidth/noise/line configuration constrain use, and fibre/other media may coexist.
  • The line trap is series-connected in the power path: low impedance at 50 Hz, high impedance over the selected carrier band, confining carrier energy toward the intended line.
  • The coupling capacitor/CVTand line-matching unit provide a shunt carrier path, impedance matching and separation from power-frequency/high-voltage stresses; the communications terminal is not connected directly to HV.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For an ideal coupling capacitor, Xc=1/(2πfC).For 5nF, Xc≈636.6kΩat 50 Hz and 318.3Ωat 100kHz.
  2. Frequency separation explains the principle, but actual safe coupling requires rated insulation, tuned matching and protective/drain devices—not a loose capacitor experiment.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

PLCC power-line conductor પર frequency-selective coupling/isolationથી high-frequency signal મોકલે; તે જ line power-frequency energy વહન કરતી રહે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Transmitter/receiver/modem speech, data/protection signals process કરે.
  2. Capacitor/suitable CVT coupling, drain/protection, LMU/coaxial lead rated interface બનાવે.
  3. Trap main coil, tuning/protection carrier blocking band/current withstand નક્કી કરે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Terminal modulation કરે; LMU/coupling carrier inject કરે.
  2. Trap bus તરફ carrier escape મર્યાદિત કરે; remote terminal message recover કરે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Voice, telemetry/engineered protection signallingમાં ઉપયોગ; bandwidth, noise/line configuration limitations છે; fibre સાથે coexist થઈ શકે.
  • Line trap power pathમાં series છે: 50Hzમાં low/selected carrier bandમાં high impedance; carrier energy intended line તરફ રાખે.
  • Coupling capacitor/CVT/LMU shunt carrier path, matching/power-frequency-HV separation આપે; terminal સીધું HV સાથે જોડાતું નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Ideal coupling capacitor Xc=1/(2πfC); 5nFમાં50 Hz પર≈636.6kΩ/100kHz પર318.3 Ω.
  2. Frequency separation principle બતાવે; actual couplingમાં rated insulation, tuned matching/protection/drain જોઈએ—loose capacitor experiment નહીં.

title.en: 2.8 Station DCbattery: lead-acid and NiCd

h.gu: Station DC Battery: Lead-acid તથા NiCd

body.en:
Definition

A station battery supplies dependable DCenergy for protection, tripping, control, alarms and essential services when ACauxiliary supply is absent or disturbed.

Classification / scope

  • Chemistry: lead-acid/NiCd; construction: vented/VRLAwhere applicable; operating role: float standby and controlled recharge.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Lead-acid uses lead-based plates with sulphuric-acid electrolyte; NiCd uses nickel/cadmium electrodes with alkaline electrolyte. Their cell voltage, charging regime and electrolyte servicing differ.
  • Vented and valve-regulated lead-acid are not serviced identically; do not open VRLAseals or add water unless expressly permitted. The charger must match chemistry, cell count, temperature compensation and duty.
  • Float operation maintains charge while serving normal load; boost/equalise is a controlled manufacturer-approved recharge mode, not a universal voltage to force onto connected DC loads.
  • Battery room ventilation, eye/face protection, insulated tools, no sparks and chemistry-specific spill response are essential; cadmium/lead disposal follows hazardous-waste rules.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Station battery AC auxiliary absent/disturbed હોય ત્યારે protection, tripping, control, alarm/essential servicesને dependable DC energy આપે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Chemistry: lead-acid/NiCd; construction: vented/VRLA જ્યાં applicable; role: float standby/controlled recharge.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Lead-acidમાં lead plates/sulphuric acid; NiCdમાં nickel/cadmium/alkaline electrolyte. Cell voltage, charging/electrolyte servicing જુદાં.
  • Vented/VRLA service સમાન નહીં; permission વિના VRLA seal ખોલવા/water ઉમેરવા નહીં.Charger chemistry, cell count/temperature/duty match કરવો.
  • Float charge maintain/normal load આપે; boost/equalise OEM-approved recharge છે, connected DC loads પર universal voltage નહીં.
  • Ventilation, eye/face PPE, insulated tools, no sparks/chemistry-specific spill response જરૂરી; lead/cadmium disposal hazardous-waste rules મુજબ.

body.en:
Definition

A battery charger converts ACauxiliary power into regulated DCsuited to the battery and connected DCsystem, with protection, monitoring and controlled recharge functions.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Healthy AC feeds the DC loads and maintains the battery in its approved charging mode.
  2. On AC loss, the battery supports DC loads through the designed distribution/protection until restored or rated autonomy expires.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Rectifier/regulator, filter, DCdistribution, protective devices and measurement/alarm circuits form a coordinated DCsystem. Ripple or earth faults can affect sensitive controls.
  • Float load and recharge capability must be coordinated for simultaneous demand; capacity tests use an approved discharge profile and end-voltage, not an improvised short circuit.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For a simplified constant 5Aload over 8 h, required delivered charge=It=40 Ah.
  2. With an illustrative 0.8usable fraction, the simple lower estimate is 40/0.8=50 Ah before ageing, temperature, rate, equipment voltage and design margins. Actual duty-cycle sizing is not this single quotient.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Charger AC auxiliaryને battery/connected systemને યોગ્ય regulated DCમાં બદલે અને protection, monitoring/controlled recharge આપે છે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Healthy AC DC load આપે/battery approved modeમાં charge રાખે.
  2. AC lossમાં battery designed distributionથી load support કરે, restoration/autonomy સુધી.

  • Rectifier/regulator, filter, distribution/protection, measurement/alarms coordinated DC system બનાવે.Ripple/earth faults controlsને અસર કરે.
  • Float load/recharge simultaneous demand પ્રમાણે; capacity test approved profile/end-voltageથી, improvised short નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  2. Illustrative 0.8usable fractionમાં40/0.8=50 Ah; ageing, temperature, rate, voltage/margins હજી ઉમેરવાનાં.Actual duty-cycle sizing એક quotient નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Battery troubleshooting identifies a symptom, tests plausible causes safely and selects a chemistry-compatible remedy without disabling essential protection DC.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Low DCbus voltage: check AC loss, charger trip, overload, weak cells and connections; secure protection continuity, restore approved supply and investigate before adjusting setpoints.
  • Unequal cell voltage or hot joint: compare same-condition cell readings/temperature and connection resistance by approved methods; isolate/repair suspect cells or joints under a continuity plan.
  • Excessive water loss/gassing in vented cells: check charging voltage, temperature and charger control; correct settings/ventilation with OEMadvice, never top up with acid indiscriminately.
  • Low specific gravity in suitable vented lead-acid: consider discharge, stratification or damage and verify temperature/context; this diagnostic is not transferred to NiCdor sealed cells.
  • DCearth-fault alarm: locate using approved monitoring/sectional methods without interrupting vital circuits; do not remove protective earths to silence it.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Low DC bus: AC loss, charger trip, overload, weak cell/joint જુઓ; protection continuity secure/approved supply restore કર્યા પછી setpoint તપાસો.
  • Unequal cell/hot jointમાં comparable readings/temperature/approved resistance checks; continuity plan હેઠળ repair કરો.
  • Vented cellsમાં water loss/gassing: voltage, temperature/control જુઓ; OEM મુજબ settings/ventilation સુધારો, acid indiscriminately નહીં.
  • Suitable vented lead-acidમાં low SG: discharge, stratification/damage/temperature જુઓ; આ test NiCd/sealed cellsમાં transfer નહીં.
  • DC earth alarm approved monitoring/sectional methodથી શોધો, vital circuit વિના તોડ્યા; alarm ચૂપ કરવા protective earth નહીં દૂર કરો.

"""Offline educational state models only; no network, device I/O, relay settings or VLab claim."""
from math import sqrt

def recloser(permanent=True,sectionaliser=True,max_trips=3,count_limit=2):
    if max_trips<1 or not 1<=count_limit<max_trips:raise ValueError('Need a restoration attempt after sectionaliser count')
    events=[];fault=True;isolated=False
    for n in range(1,max_trips+1):
        events.append({'event':'TRIP','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated})
        if not permanent:fault=False
        if sectionaliser and fault and n==count_limit:
            isolated=True;fault=False
            events.append({'event':'SECTIONALISER_OPEN','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':True})
        if n==max_trips:
            events.append({'event':'LOCKOUT','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated});break
        events.append({'event':'DEAD_TIME','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated})
        events.append({'event':'RECLOSE','trip':n,'upstream':'CLOSED','fault_isolated':isolated})
        if not fault:
            events.append({'event':'HEALTHY_RESTORED','trip':n,'upstream':'CLOSED','fault_isolated':isolated});break
    return events

def permit(role=True,quality='GOOD',age=0,cb='OPEN',earth='OPEN',code='01',command='CLOSE'):
    # Declared DOUBLE-POINT MODEL mapping only: 00 intermediate, 01 open, 10 closed, 11 bad.
    reasons=[]
    if not role:reasons.append('NO_AUTHORITY')
    if quality!='GOOD' or age<0 or age>2:reasons.append('BAD_OR_STALE')
    if code not in ('01','10'):reasons.append('INVALID_POSITION')
    if cb!='OPEN':reasons.append('CURRENT_NOT_REMOVED')
    if earth!='OPEN':reasons.append('EARTH_NOT_CONFIRMED_OPEN')
    if command not in ('OPEN','CLOSE'):reasons.append('BAD_COMMAND')
    if (command,code)in(('CLOSE','10'),('OPEN','01')):reasons.append('ALREADY_IN_POSITION')
    return {'allow':not reasons,'reasons':reasons,'status_map':{'00':'INTERMEDIATE','01':'OPEN','10':'CLOSED','11':'BAD'}}

def transfer(load_a,load_b,capacity_b,compatible=True,fault=False):
    if min(load_a,load_b)<0 or capacity_b<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid MVA')
    reasons=[]
    if not compatible:reasons.append('INCOMPATIBLE_SOURCES')
    if fault:reasons.append('FAULT_OR_PROTECTION_BLOCK')
    if load_a+load_b>capacity_b:reasons.append('OVERLOAD')
    return {'allow':not reasons,'combined_MVA':load_a+load_b,'reasons':reasons,
            'policy':'Open-transition classroom capacity screen only; actual transfer needs approved order, voltage/phase/protection checks, no unapproved paralleling.'}

def oltc(vin=11000,target=11000,ratio=1.0,step=0.0125,deadband=100,delay=3,elapsed=3,tap=0,min_tap=-8,max_tap=8):
    # Model vout=vin*(ratio + tap*step). Positive tap increases this controlled output ratio.
    if vin<=0 or target<=0 or ratio<=0 or step<=0 or deadband<0 or delay<0 or elapsed<0 or not min_tap<=tap<=max_tap:raise ValueError('Invalid model inputs')
    before=vin*(ratio+tap*step);action='HOLD';aftertap=tap
    if abs(before-target)>deadband and elapsed>=delay:
        wanted=tap+(1 if before<target else -1)
        if min_tap<=wanted<=max_tap:aftertap=wanted;action='STEP'
        else:action='LIMIT'
    elif abs(before-target)>deadband:action='WAIT'
    return {'before':before,'tap':aftertap,'after':vin*(ratio+aftertap*step),'action':action}

def plc(start=False,stop_ok=True,estop_ok=True,overload_ok=True,guard_ok=True,latched=False):
    # No safety certification. Real emergency-stop circuit must be appropriately independent/hardwired.
    q=bool(stop_ok and estop_ok and overload_ok and guard_ok and (start or latched))
    return {'motor':q,'run_latch':q,'alarm':not(overload_ok and guard_ok and estop_ok)}

def fault_zone(zone):
    routes={'FEEDER':{'trips':['FEEDER_CB'],'healthy_bus':True},'TRANSFORMER':{'trips':['HV_CB','LV_CB'],'healthy_bus':False},'BUS':{'trips':['ALL_ZONE_BOUNDARIES'],'healthy_bus':False}}
    if zone not in routes:raise ValueError('Unknown zone')
    return routes[zone]

q.en: Is interconnecting service always a separate-winding transformer?

a.en: No. Autotransformers may be used where system/insulation design allows, but they do not provide full galvanic isolation.
a.gu: નહીં.Design permits તો autotransformer હોઈ શકે, full galvanic isolation નહીં.

q.en: Can a generic isolator clear feeder fault current?

a.en: No. Use a device with the necessary interrupting duty; disconnector isolation duty is different.
a.gu: નહીં.Required interrupting device જોઈએ; DS isolation duty જુદી છે.

q.en: When does a counting sectionaliser open?

a.en: After its coordinated count during the upstream recloser dead interval, not while interrupting fault current itself.
a.gu: Coordinated count પછી upstream dead intervalમાં; પોતે fault interrupt કરતો નથી.
